items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He and Jones, Richard M. Jones... So he was the piano player in this group?

ctx.x: Yeah, he's the one, King Oliver's nephew, Dave Nelson...
He wrote the "Mule Face Blues" and some other things. He was a good arranger. He was out of Chicago. And he and Jones, Richard M. Jones...
